title: After The General's first Love Returns
author: 宇宙第一红
synopsis:
It took Bai Qingning three years to marry her husband, and she realized that she had never been in his heart.

After her husband's beloved Zhao Hongzhu returned, he ignored her and even killed her. He sought a position for a newcomer, but his relatives watched coldly. His loyal servants were displaced and separated, and when he was about to die, he even brought her mute slave to die with him.

With one more eye open, Bai Qingning returned to the year Zhao Hongzhu had just returned.

She used every possible means, bit by bit, to drag all the scumbags and bitches into the endless abyss, and then she relaxed and separated, picked up her mute slave and took good care of him.

And the slave? He was a lowly creature who had fallen into a ditch, a slave who had never seen light, and she was his moonlight. A moonlight he did not dare to look at with his eyes, fearing that the moonlight would see the greed he tried to hide, so he lowered his head and looked at the moon's shadow in the cup. But he had a secret. Maybe one day he can look directly at the moon.
